descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S15 Nursing Home chart wiring on main (mocked AI): Admission Summary label, New Admission → SNF admission, Save & Extract, SNF billing code, Medications panel

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Nursing Home has Save & Extract, a billing block and a Medications panel, all working (none were present in Run 6) (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1c The summary label is 'Background Summary' in Hospital and 'Admission Summary' in Nursing Home (UAT TC-21 step 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U4 Default template: the admission-status badge pre-selects the template (New Admission → H&P / SNF admission, Follow-up → SOAP progress / SNF follow-up, Consult → Consult note / SNF consult), and the p … (UAT TC-21; UAT TC-21 step 1 (default template); TFA-92599 AC 6; TFA-92599 rule 4; TFA-92584 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's suite at e02167f; each test uses action-observer mocks, so no live AI and no E2E_AI_LIVE

When Run the four tests by title

Then The NH hub reaches every chart tab and shows 'Admission Summary' with no 'Background Summary'. New Admission pre-selects SNF admission. Save & Extract saves the notes, closes and adds tasks, and keeps a codeword task verbatim. A generated NH note requests and saves an SNF code. The parsed medications reach the NH Medications panel.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions, wiring only. The hub test also asserts that the NH card shows the resident's diagnosis, which contradicts UAT TC-03 (Q8; TC-01 Q4), so its Pass is no evidence for identity fields (U1b → S16). Its handoff check only proves the 'Handoff Summary' heading is reachable (U8 → S18). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

Detail:

Local 25acd727, mocked copies of Tim's four titles (ctx-tc21-handoff.spec.ts), not lane A: on this build the hub title opens Handoff and reaches the live ai/assist:generateHandoff (not mocked there), and the matrix title 'a generated Nursing Home note requests and saves an SNF code' no longer exists (cases/e2e-titles.tsv 25acd727: the nearest are 'a saved Nursing Home suggestion shows its SNF code without another call' and 'snf: Generate saves a durable billing job without a browser billing call'; the second stores a note and queues the server billing job, so it cannot run locally). 4/4 judged: hub copy reached add, scan, inbox, Task Export, Handoff (generateHandoff answered at the socket), Settings and every chart tab, with 'Admission Summary' (no 'Background Summary'), New Admission pre-selecting SNF admission and the 4 SNF templates; Save & Extract saved the dictation, closed INR, kept PT open, added the pharmacy task and the codeword task verbatim; the NH billing block shows a stored SNF follow-up suggestion as CODE 99309 and a stored SNF consult suggestion as 99305 (family 99304-99306) with its level, no job queued and no browser billing call; pre-round Save Note puts the parsed medications in the NH Medications panel after a reload. Recorded: Tim's hub test asserts the diagnosis on the NH card, which UAT TC-01 / TC-03 rule out (B28).

Evidence: 7 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: Tim's Nursing Home specs run on their own fixture accounts made through e2e/support/backend.ts (admin key) and answer every AI call with action-observer mocks; dev has one shared account, no admin key and no action mock, so they run on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
